# Mead

# Introduction

Mead refers to items which can be consumed for temporary health and stamina boosts, as well as preventing harmful status effects.
Mead must first be crafted into a mead base at a Mead ketill and then fermented using a Fermenter.
Mead can be consumed with or without a Tankard, Dvergr tankard or a Horn of Celebration.

## Cooldown

Meads have cooldown during which a player cannot drink another mead of the same type. Some meads share the same exclusion group:
• Healing meads group: Minor healing mead Medium healing mead Major healing mead Lingering healing mead
• Stamina meads group: Minor stamina mead Medium stamina mead Lingering stamina mead
• Eitr meads group: Minor eitr mead Lingering eitr mead

## List of mead

As listed below, duration refers to the length of time over which the mead provides its effect, whereas cooldown is the length of time during which a player cannot drink another mead of the same type. Unless otherwise listed, each type of mead weighs 1.0 and stacks to 10.
